title: Dallas Christmas Lights Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Children are not allowed to sit on laps. Carry on suitcase are not allowed in our excursion.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join us for a festive journey through the dazzling streets of the Park Cities (Highland Park and University Park), Dallas’s premier destination for unforgettable holiday lights and decorations. This public tour is the perfect way to experience the magic of the season with friends, family, or fellow holiday enthusiasts. Along our route, we will make special stops at the neighborhood's most famous, viral houses, giving you the perfect opportunity to step out, take spectacular pictures, and truly immerse yourself in the holiday spirit. To make your evening even sweeter, a complimentary cup of hot chocolate and a festive holiday cookie are included in your ticket price!
